U_0x014C8A.en:
A machine built by the Holy Kingdom of Langran in the subterranean world of <La Gias>. Blessed by the wind spirit Cyfis, it is known as the "<Masoukishin> of the Wind." Its Fulcanelli perpetual engine requires the operator's (pilot's) <Prana> for peak efficiency; <Prana> is essentially "ki" or "aura," so output depends greatly on the operator's aptitude.
The airtight frame allows action underwater and in space, and a self-circulation system protects the operator's body on long sorties. Aether - massless energy at rest in absolute coordinates - serves as its magical propulsion medium. The Orichalconium armor, sealed at particle level with numerological ward patterns, grants high magical defense.
Its Laplace Demon-type computer calculates causality to predict events, though this hinges on the operator's own magic. "Cybuster" is a guardian name against magical attack, not its true name.

U_0x0156CD.en: VThe Valsione, second Valsion-series unit, enhanced with <La Gias> alchemy. The ABMD system drives its frame and the DML system traces the pilot's motions, giving it flexible, human-like movement no other humanoid weapon can match.

U_0x0158A0.en: SShu's anti-alien combat <Armored Module>. It runs on an antimatter engine, with armor of ultra-tensile titanium reinforced at the particle level. Built for firepower and defense over mobility, its attack power is immense; co-designer Eric Wong said that with a pilot of superhuman ability it could crush the world's forces in a day. Shu's Kabbalah program reportedly lets it use astral energy. It hides many black boxes, but since Shu went independent after the <DC War> began, its sealed secrets remain a mystery.

U_0x0171A6.en: A highly mobile wind <Elemental> that excels at hit-and-run attacks. Its standard armament falls short of other <Elemental>s, so lesser pilots cannot draw out its full power. Output is stable, and its contract spirit accepts nearly any pilot - a trait that spawned the mass-production Gadyful. Its spirit is Soleid of the Sandstorm, a low-rank wind spirit.

U_0x0173AA.en: A super <Elemental> designed by Xenia. Unlike conventional <Elemental>s, it draws on Huckebein series data, giving it a distinctive look. It has no spirit contract, but its pseudo-<Prana> generator lets a pilot with high <Prana> wield power rivaling a <Masoukishin>. The tradeoff is a rather short operating time.

U_0x0192E6.en: A humanoid mobile weapon of the Re-Technologists, built for aerial and ranged combat. Besides the Vector Guns and Force Busters built into its arms, it can swap both arms with weapons launched from its WBH (weapon box hanger) "Ars Nova." Like the Aile Chevalier, it carries the "Sympathia" and "Res Arcana."

U_0x019755.en: A special humanoid mobile weapon of the Re-Technologists: the Ganador and Strega transformed and combined. Its two Res Arcanas grant immense power.

U_0x000FDE.en: Unit 2 of the R Series of <Personal Trooper>s from the <SRX Project>, officially "REAL PERSONAL TROOPER TYPE-2 POWERED." A heavy <Personal Trooper> for beam bombardment, carrying the <Tronium> Engine that powers the SRX. Firepower and armor are high, but unstable engine output and poor mobility are weaknesses; within the R Series it handles suppressive fire and artillery support. Plus parts - the Hyzol Launcher, a heavy metal particle cannon, and shoulder armor - make it the R-2 Powered. In the combined SRX, R-2's pilot regulates the engine's output, handles damage control, and monitors the other pilots' condition. Lacking the <T-LINK System>, its pilot need not be a Psychodriver.
